last_review.summary: AUTH-011-A meets the acceptance criteria and architecture constraints. API keys are strictly parsed, hashed using the existing SHA-256 convention, resolved without persisting or returning secrets, checked for environment/status/revocation/expiration, and conditionally marked used before an agent-bound Principal is returned. The persisted credential exclusively supplies credentialId, agentId, and scopes. Changes are confined to src/api-credentials/, and deterministic build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
